shortBulletSummary: Fed's Hawkish Stance: June FOMC hints at potential rate hikes, not cuts, pressuring crypto assets.
Extreme Fear in Crypto: Fear & Greed Index at 17-18 ("Extreme Fear") as majors consolidate near $60K BTC.
Geopolitical Tensions: US-Iran Strait of Hormuz tensions persist, adding global market risk.
ETF Outflows Continue: Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs experienced significant outflows, dampening demand.
Regulatory Clarity Hope: CLARITY Act progresses in Senate, offering long-term US crypto regulatory hope.
